description: Query of `GET /mgmt/v1/agents/{member_id}/deliveries`: long-poll after a member seq.

after.description: Return entries with `seq > after`. K2 sends the previous page's `next_after`.

limit.description: At most this many entries (1–500, default 100; S9 §12, additive).

timeout_ms.description: Long-poll up to this long (≤ 25000, default 25000).

title: DeliveriesQuery
